merge: recursive objects; arrays, null and scalars replace

coverage: Settings UI saves to global file
Workspace UI saves to highest existing override

notes: Former workspace pending-write recovery was migrated and verified, including conflicts.
Browser, theme and desktop fixtures now use isolated settings paths.
The legacy theme fixture wrote a test-only global value during development; the fixture was isolated and existing desktop preferences restored into the user file.
External editors can race the final filesystem rename; writes are atomic per file, not transactional across files.
